projects.title: Intruder response
projects.goal: an automatic intruder alert for the bridge: a silent alert to the security watch at once; ship-wide yellow after thirty seconds unless the bridge acknowledges; one word from the bridge stands it down; then drill it; the trigger becomes a constant spectral model of the bridge compared against every accounted presence (life signs, combadges, Data), flagging any mismatch either way; counted: bodies of any species, not clutter (Lloyd); Data notes Q sat motionless in the captain's chair, so 'moving under its own power' alone would miss him; rule: body-shaped and unlogged fires it, heat confirms it; it is the default for any intruder, Q the case to beat
